declaration.purpose: Turn a Strategy H APPROVE into a simulated paper position and manage it to its exit with rules frozen before any H paper result exists. Paper only: no broker, no exchange, no real money.
declaration.supersedes_for_paper: the position_rule block of H_V2_D7_FORWARD_SHADOW_V1 (which stays frozen and keeps describing the forward shadow, which itself never holds a position)

launch.why: Only an APPROVE recorded after the paper launch timestamp is an entry signal. WATCH and REJECT states that existed before launch are never turned into hypothetical trades.

account.convention_source: Strategy E DEFAULT_INITIAL_EQUITY = 10000 (no shared A/E paper account abstraction exists; H keeps its own book, like E)

signals.source: H's own forward ledger (append-only); a row's decision_time is the decision effective time

sizing.equity_basis: paper NAV at the close of the last stored session before the entry session (initial equity before any NAV exists)
sizing.quantity: floor(slot_budget / buy_effective_price(raw open)) whole shares, the E convention (ROUND_DOWN)
sizing.no_free_slot: APPROVE_WAITING_SLOT (queued in decision-time order; enters at the first session open at which a slot is free and its decision is still APPROVE)
sizing.already_open_ticker: a new APPROVE for a ticker H already holds is recorded as APPROVE_IGNORED_ALREADY_OPEN

execution.cost_config: app.execution.config.ExecutionConfig() = execution_v0 (spread 10bp + slippage 5bp price-embedded, commission 10bp per leg on raw notional, fx 0)
execution.accounting: app.broker.accounting ACCOUNTING_V1 (net = gross at fill prices - commission - fx)
execution.entry_price: raw = the regular-session OPEN of the first trading session whose open is strictly after decision_time
execution.pending_state: PENDING_ENTRY until that session's bar is stored
execution.missing_open: the entry stays PENDING_ENTRY and fills at the first later stored session that has an open; never at a close, never at a price before the decision
execution.price_source: H's own D7 price store (Massive grouped daily: open, high, low, close)
execution.planned_initial_risk: entry notional (H has no stop level; R multiples are return on notional)

exits.evaluated_from: the first session strictly after the entry session (the entry session's own bar is not used for exits)
exits.levels_source: TP1, TP2 and Bear of the APPROVE row that opened the position, frozen at entry

TP1.fill: raw = open if open >= TP1, else TP1 when high >= TP1

TP2.fill: raw = open if open >= TP2, else TP2 when high >= TP2

BEAR_BREACH.fill: raw = open if open <= Bear, else Bear when low <= Bear
BEAR_BREACH.not_available: NOT_EVALUATED: no stop of any kind is substituted (VRRM: NEGATIVE_IMPLIED_EQUITY)

exits.same_bar_order: execution_v0 ambiguous_bar_policy WORST_CASE: when one daily bar touches Bear and a TP and the open does not decide it, Bear is taken first. TP1 then TP2 in the same bar is allowed (one upward path).

DECISION_DOWNGRADE.trigger: a later forward-ledger row for the same ticker with APPROVE->WATCH or APPROVE->REJECT
DECISION_DOWNGRADE.action: sell all remaining at the open of the first session strictly after that row's decision_time

THESIS_INVALIDATED.trigger: a forward-ledger row for the ticker carrying cause THESIS_INVALIDATED, written by a D3->D6 re-evaluation
THESIS_INVALIDATED.action: sell all remaining at the next session open
THESIS_INVALIDATED.why: D3 invalidation candidates are free-text conditions with sources. No frozen contract evaluates them mechanically, so V1 invents none and acts only on an explicit re-evaluation record.

exits.pending_entry_cancelled_when: the ticker's decision is no longer APPROVE before the entry fills (APPROVE_CANCELLED_DECISION_CHANGED)

marks.nav: cash + sum(shares * close) at each stored session close after launch
marks.missing_close_for_held_ticker: NAV_INCOMPLETE for that session; the last price is never substituted
marks.session_gap: processing stops before an expected session that the store does not hold (PAPER_STALLED_AT_GAP)

research_budget.production_daily_budget_status: NOT_APPROVED (operator decision; until set, no model call is scheduled)
research_budget.batch_budget: each research batch freezes its own sample, model and hard cap in a preregistration before any call
